content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 5 up, 0 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 6 of 6 planned. Sets: 56 (last week 56).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- 槓鈴臥推: 80 kg x 8 (last week 77.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.2%, 8 sets this week
- 深蹲: 100 kg x 6 (last week 97.5 kg x 6), estimated 1RM up 2.6%, 8 sets this week
- 槓鈴划船: 70 kg x 8 (last week 67.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
- 羅馬尼亞硬舉: 90 kg x 8 (last week 87.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 8 sets this week
- 滑輪下拉: 55 kg x 10 (last week 52.5 kg x 10), estimated 1RM up 4.8%, 6 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): 槓鈴臥推 80 kg x 8; 深蹲 100 kg x 6; 槓鈴划船 70 kg x 8; 羅馬尼亞硬舉 90 kg x 8; 滑輪下拉 55 kg x 10.
Sets per muscle this week (range 10-20 a week for chest, back, legs, shoulders, glutes): chest 14 (last week 14), shoulders 4 (last week 4), triceps 4 (last week 4), back 14 (last week 14), biceps 4 (last week 4), legs 16 (last week 16).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "增肌".
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): "側平舉的時候右肩會卡卡的，有點痛".
Rules that fired. Advise only on these, by id:
- id "low_volume:shoulders", priority 50, data {"sets":4,"previousPerWeek":4,"target":10,"addSets":6}. Advice: Add addSets sets (from the data) each week for that muscle, which brings it to 10 a week, spread over sessions the user already does.

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 40 characters.
2. items: advice for at most 3 of the fired rules, most important first: usually by priority, but the goal or the note may change the order. A deload, if it fired, is always included and first. Each action is one or two short sentences saying exactly what to do next week, with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's note: if it mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文, Taiwan usage) with full-width punctuation (，。！？「」), and use the Chinese exercise names given above.
